definitions.explanation: Referring to actions, preparations, or information that come before a main event or situation.

examples.japanese: {事前|じぜん}に{予約|よやく}が{必要|ひつよう}です。
{事前|じぜん}の{準備|じゅんび}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
{事前|じぜん}に{連絡|れんらく}をいただければ{助|たす}かります。
examples.english: It would help if you could contact us in advance.

notes:
WORD STRUCTURE:
{事|じ} (matter, event) + {前|ぜん} (before)
Literally: "before the matter" → "beforehand"

GRAMMAR:
Can function as:
・Adverb: {事前|じぜん}に〜 (in advance ~)
・Noun modifier: {事前|じぜん}の〜 (prior ~, advance ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{事前|じぜん}に{連絡|れんらく}する - to contact in advance
・{事前|じぜん}{予約|よやく} - advance reservation
・{事前|じぜん}{準備|じゅんび} - prior preparation
・{事前|じぜん}{承認|しょうにん} - prior approval
・{事前|じぜん}{登録|とうろく} - pre-registration

ANTONYM:
・{事後|じご} - after the fact, post-

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{前|まえ}もって - in advance, beforehand
・あらかじめ - beforehand, previously
